Greek key bracelet, square-link chain, Egyptian pendant, ring and hairpin are white metal with no readable marks. Marcasite watch is a ladies cocktail watch, dial readable, a few stones possibly missing (cannot confirm), running unknown.
lots.condition: Used, untested. Pearl strand needs restringing and a clasp. Watch running unknown. No obvious breakage seen.
